03 / The Cultivation Floor

BUILT SMALL.

Cannanaut is a South Dakota cultivation operation focused on doing a smaller number of things well. We keep the lineup intentional, document our batches, and work directly with licensed dispensary partners.

Explore Our Story →
04 / Our Story

BUILT FROM THE
GROUND UP.

Cannanaut started in 2021 with a simple idea: build something local, do the work ourselves, and grow higher together. We built our own cultivation rooms, tables, and watering stations from the ground up—one wall, one system, and one long day at a time.

What began with a crew, a vision, and a wide-open warehouse became a working South Dakota cultivation operation focused on small-batch flower, intentional genetics, and strong relationships with licensed dispensary partners.
